title: Webb County Sheriff Shares Thanksgiving Greeting, Reminds Drivers Not to Drink and Drive
excerpt: The Webb County Sheriff's Office shared a Thanksgiving greeting for Webb County families, with Sheriff Martin Cuellar wishing everyone a safe and joyful holiday and reminding drivers not to drink and drive.
content:
The Webb County Sheriff's Office shared a Thanksgiving greeting for Webb County families on Wednesday, Nov. 25, 2026, ahead of Thanksgiving Day on Thursday, Nov. 26.

Sheriff Martin Cuellar said the office is especially grateful this Thanksgiving for the people and families who make Webb County such a special place to call home, and wished everyone a holiday filled with love, laughter, and countless blessings.

The sheriff also wished everyone a safe and joyful holiday and reminded drivers: don't drink and drive.
